lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into at least four discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular blobs, forming a series of high-contrast nodes against the darker background.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, separating a lighter dorsal region from a shadowed ventral region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch or indentation located on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast elongated feature attached to the pectoral fin; intricate maze-like (vermiculated) patterning on the cranial region anterior to the gills.
